scenario: A MIDI keyboard's sustain pedal, pitch bend and all notes off play on its track
name: companion: on MIDI channel 2 (the bass): the sustain pedal holds C4 after its release until the pedal lifts; pitch bend up turns A3 into B3 (two semitones) and back; all notes off (CC123) silences it; on channel 1 (the chords' piano) bend turns A3 into B3 too
